plan: With a private value of $39, I want to maximize potential profit. The optimal strategy is to bid just below my true value to minimize overpaying. Since the third-highest bid determines the payment, I'll bid strategically to win while minimizing my payment. A bid around $38-$39 gives me a good chance of winning without risking paying more than the item's worth to me. I'll aim to bid $38.5 to balance winning probability and potential profit.

My private value is $27. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. This minimizes risk of overpaying while ensuring I win if my value is genuinely higher than others. Since values are randomly drawn, I can't predict others' values. Bidding exactly $27 means I'll win if my value is highest, and only pay less than my value. Any higher bid risks overpaying, any lower bid risks losing a potentially profitable item.
